description.en: dsh-sd-bridge-guard插件已发布，可以帮你完善提示词，提高图片质量，并做到dsh无限制生图
边做边压 Live Compact. Compress the finished turn in place and keep the prefix cache.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。

Structural code intelligence for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — gives the agent codegraph and codegraph_index tools to find where a symbol is declared, what calls it, and what a change   reaches, from a tree-sitter index it builds itself. Compatible with the codegraph CLI's on-disk format.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代码结构分析工具，快速定位符号声明、调用关系及变更影响范围。

description.en: 自动修复客户端引起的请求失败，并让版本不匹配的 DSH 插件能装上、能跑起来。

Local music library for DeepSeek Harness: scan a folder, browse tracks with cover art and tags, and play through a sidebar-panel player with loop, shuffle and volume. · DSH 本地音乐插件：扫描音乐目录、读取封面与标签、侧栏入口 + 全屏播放器。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地音乐播放器：曲库扫描、歌单、同步歌词、在线元数据匹配、标签与封面编辑、封面网格和实时频谱条。

description.en: ZCode-style SSH/WSL/Docker remote workspaces for DeepSeek Harness
Select text in a DSH reply: a floating toolbar that quotes it into the composer draft or opens a side chat about it.
A local knowledge pulgin for DeepSeek Harness

System Duo for DeepSeek Harness. Make your agent think fast and slow: System One decision models triage, guard, shield, mask and check your agent loop beside System Two (vllm-sr/auto), with a free app.vllm-sr.ai key.
Inject soulbridge context into DSH sessions and feed user turns back as observations.
LLM-backed prompt optimization bundle for DeepSeek Harness
Message box for DeepSeek Harness: finished-conversation and pending-approval notifications with jump-to-conversation and inline approval.
三重一大决策台账核对（按前置研究、会议审议与决议记录核对程序留痕，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 检查国企「三重一大」决策台账的程序留痕，看议题是否记录提案依据、前置研究等环节是否齐全。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: the claude-motion skill from baoyu-design. The agent writes short animated films as code, scene by scene, and plays them in a local Motion player that exports MP4 or GIF.
DSH LEWIS ENCHANTMENT · 附魔台｜开机动画：铺满当前窗口的完整开场、自定义视频与封面、启动检查更新和磨砂提示。

Service Definition for the DeepSeek Harness code-graph capability seam (ctx.codegraph): a graph-store and graph-indexer provider registry with per-query, order-independent selection over eight normalized structural queries
Cabinet Mode (内阁模式) for DeepSeek Harness: a declarative DSH bundle that adds a dual-identity Lead/teammate agent preset for the Great Ming Research Bureau cabinet team.
Workspace- and session-scoped rules for DeepSeek Harness · 按工作区/会话分层维护守则，会话里逐层勾选带入，默认关闭

Model-facing codegraph tools for DeepSeek Harness — a read-only codegraph tool with ten structural query operations plus a codegraph_index tool that builds or refreshes the index on its own timeout budget
维修工单结算核对（按项目金额、配件工时合计与结算总额核对算术自洽，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 自动核对机动车维修工单的金额和填写完整性，算错、漏填一眼就能发现。

description.en: Self-built code-graph indexer for DeepSeek Harness — parses a workspace with web-tree-sitter and writes schema version 4 to .codegraph/codegraph.db, the same on-disk format the codegraph CLI writes, so no external indexer is required
给她一个能记账的心情层：心情必须有来处，改动必须有账，她自己能停能查
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle that registers the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server as mcp__rea__* tools — third-party adapter
description.zh: 把 REA 逆向工程 MCP 服务器接进 DSH，让你直接调用工具拆解分析任意目标。

description.en: Skill that deploys a folder to a public HTTPS address on Back4app with the Back4app CLI, on a temporary account with a claim link to keep the web app.
description.zh: Skill that deploys a folder to a public HTTPS address on Back4app with the Back4app CLI, on a temporary account with a claim link to keep the web app.

description.en: Colorful sticky notes for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with add, edit, bulk delete, and daily, weekly, monthly or one-time reminders.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏多彩便签，支持增删改、批量删除，以及每天、每周、每月和单次提醒。

description.en: Floating ball showing the signed-in DeepSeek account balance (OAuth), with live pricing, today's price curve and a token-consumption estimate range.
description.zh: 悬浮球显示已登录 DeepSeek 账户余额（OAuth），附带实时价格、今日价格走势与 token 消耗估算区间。

description.en: AgentTeams for DeepSeek Harness — an independent design branch of NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams; do not install both, since both register the same `agent-teams` row. Multi-agent team collaboration with a captain and members, tasks that carry dependencies, and messaging, all driven by natural language, plus a tree monitor in the web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AgentTeams 多智能体团队协作插件，NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams 的独立设计分支；不要与上游同装：两者注册同一个 `agent-teams` 行。提供队长与成员、带依赖的任务与消息传递，全部由自然语言驱动，Web 界面提供树状实时监视。

description.en: A conversation view beside Chat and Trajectory that turns a DSH session into a character stage, with Codex Pet sprites, comic bubbles and a completion report listing the files and attachments the turn produced.
description.zh: 与 Chat、Trajectory 并列的会话视图，把会话变成角色舞台：支持 Codex Pet 精灵动画与漫画气泡，并在完成时汇报本轮产生的文件和附件。

description.en: Zero-dependency browser hand & eye over CDP: drives your own Chrome/Edge with real clicks, Chinese IME typing, scrolling and text/selector element picking, and captures whole-page evidence into one replayable folder — DOM, accessibility tree, screenshots, cookies, storage, console, HAR, resource waterfall and perf metrics.
description.zh: 零依赖的浏览器「手和眼」（CDP 接入）：直接驱动本机 Chrome/Edge，真实点击、中文输入、滚动、按文字或选择器定位；并能把整页抓成可离线复盘的证据包——DOM、无障碍树、截图、Cookie、本地存储、控制台、HAR、资源瀑布与性能指标。

description.en: Persistent Codex advisor threads for DSH sessions, with six native tools, a Codex trail, a sidebar status card, and explicit model/effort provenance. Requires a locally installed Codex CLI with app-server support and a logged-in ChatGPT/Codex account (the CLI is not bundled); tested on Windows 11 with DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话提供可跨请求续聊的 Codex 顾问线程：六个原生工具、Codex 轨迹、侧栏状态卡，以及每轮 model/effort 来源。需本机安装支持 app-server 的 Codex CLI 并登录 ChatGPT/Codex 账号（插件不自带 CLI）；已在 Windows 11 + DSH 桌面 0.2.1-rc.5 上验证。

description.en: Connects a locally installed, signed-in Codex CLI to individual Harness sessions for planning, code review, and optional image analysis; the CLI must be installed and authenticated separately. Verified on Windows; macOS and Linux use the manual CLI install and are not hardware-verified.
description.zh: 在指定 Harness 会话中接入本机已安装并登录的 Codex CLI，提供方案、代码审查和可选图片识别；CLI 需另行安装并授权。已在 Windows 实机验证，macOS 与 Linux 走手动安装 CLI 的方式、尚未实机验收。

description.en: Links source material and main-chat instructions, and coordinates translation and refinement tasks with the companion translation plugin. Linked submission needs submissions protocol 1: when the host lacks it, Windows Desktop installs a bundled host patch on first use (a full exit and reopen is required); other platforms need a host that already provides it.
description.zh: 将原稿与主聊天要求联动提交，配合翻译插件协调翻译与润色任务。联动发送需要 submissions protocol 1：宿主没有该接口时，Windows 桌面版会在首次使用时安装随包的宿主补丁（需完全退出并重开 DSH）；其他平台则需要宿主本身已提供该接口。

description.en: macOS computer use with eight computer_* tools: accessibility-tree and Vision OCR screen reading, actions by element index or visible label that also reach background windows, and CoreGraphics mouse and keyboard events with a resident low-latency daemon for game-grade input sequences; its Swift helpers compile on first use, so there is no runtime dependency.
description.zh: macOS 电脑操作：8 个 computer_* 工具，读屏走辅助功能树与 Vision OCR，按元素 index 或可见文字执行 press / focus / set_value / click（后台窗口也能操作），CoreGraphics 鼠标键盘事件走常驻 daemon 低延迟通道，支持游戏级连招序列；自带的 Swift 助手首次调用时编译，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Searches the whole conversation — not just the loaded window — from a button in the conversation header, opens the results in the right sidebar, paints every keyword yellow in both your messages and the replies, and jumps the conversation to the hit. History search runs on the host log, so it still works when the full-text index is disabled.
description.zh: 在对话头部加一个搜索按钮，结果显示在右侧栏；整段历史都能搜（不只是已加载的那部分），命中关键词在用户消息和 AI 回复里都标黄，点结果可跳转到对话中的位置。历史检索走宿主日志，所以全文索引被关闭时也能用。

description.en: DSH design-delivery plugin with 10 tools for UI lint, design tokens, three-candidate shortlists, JND parameter probes, and PPTX deck check/export/render. Deck tools need ppt-master, Python with python-pptx and DSH's LibreOffice Kit; design_capture needs a real browser.
description.zh: DSH 设计交付插件：10 个工具覆盖界面审查、设计 tokens、三方向粗选、JND 参数精调，以及 PPTX 质检/导出/渲染。deck 工具依赖 ppt-master、带 python-pptx 的 Python 与 DSH 自带的 LibreOffice Kit；design_capture 需要真实浏览器。

description.en: A whale or pixel-crab pet that perches on the DSH input box and reacts to the current session (working, awaiting approval, done, error), eats the tokens each turn spends and keeps a diary.
description.zh: 扒在 DSH 输入框上的小鲸鱼或像素小螃蟹，跟着当前对话变化状态（干活、等你确认、完成、出错），吃掉每轮花掉的 token，还会写日记。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness document-redaction workbench adapted from whatcccup/cece_legal_skills (MIT). Processes DOCX, PDF, TXT and Markdown locally, with human review, PDF masking and OCR-line review, case-consistent placeholders, Word restoration, history and optional Agent rule previews and rollback. Requires Python 3.9+ and first-run dependency downloads; model access is needed only for rule generation. Version 1.4.0 is a prerelease verified on macOS Web and DSH desktop; new Windows setup and OCR paths await on-device revalidation. The upstream is a standalone offline tool/SkillHub skill, not a DSH plugin, so it cannot be installed alongside this bundle.
description.zh: 基于 whatcccup/cece_legal_skills（MIT）适配的 DeepSeek Harness 文书脱敏工作台。在本机处理 DOCX、PDF、TXT 和 Markdown，提供人工复核、PDF 框选遮盖与 OCR 行核对、同案占位符、Word 还原、历史记录及可选 Agent 规则预览与回退。需 Python 3.9+，首次准备依赖需要联网；仅规则生成需要模型。1.4.0 为预发布，已在 macOS Web 与 DSH 桌面验证；新增 Windows 安装与 OCR 路径待实机复验。上游是独立离线工具/SkillHub 技能，不是 DSH 插件，无法在 DSH 内与本插件同装。

description.en: Drives the local Doubao desktop client over CDP so the agent can generate images with the doubao_paint tool, covering text-to-image, image-to-image and batch prompts, and downloads the watermark-free originals from Doubao's own CDN instead of the thumbnail with a burned-in logo. Requires the Doubao client installed, signed in and started with a debug port.
description.zh: 用 CDP 驱动本机豆包桌面客户端出图：doubao_paint 支持文生图、图生图与批量提示词，并从豆包 CDN 下载无水印原图而不是带角标的缩略图；需要已登录的豆包客户端以调试端口启动。

description.en: Feishu OAuth login reduces the need to distribute the DSH owner token while retaining token login; authorized users receive native owner session cookies with shared owner privileges, without per-user isolation.
description.zh: 通过飞书 OAuth 登录减少分发 DSH owner token 的需要，同时保留 token 登录；获准用户使用原生 owner 会话 Cookie，共享 owner 权限，不提供逐用户隔离。

description.en: Right-sidebar flow editor for prompts, model switches, commands, condition branches and loops, executed only at turn boundaries so an in-flight request keeps its model.
description.zh: 右侧栏可视化流程编辑器：把提示词、切换模型、命令、条件分支与循环连成一张图，只在轮次边界执行，在途请求与断连重试保持原模型。

description.en: Eleven game-development agent presets cut by workflow stage — concept, design, build, art and audio, QA, release, narrative, level, engine — plus one orchestrator that delegates across them, carrying 37 bundled skills. Regroups the 48 agent prompts of Claude Code Game Studios (MIT) by stage so each preset loads only the skills its stage needs. Installs with dsh plugin add; run node install.mjs once afterwards to deploy the skills the presets reference.
description.zh: 11 套按工作流阶段切分的游戏开发 agent 预设——概念、设计、实现、美术与音频、QA、发布、叙事、关卡、引擎——外加一个跨阶段委派的总控，附带 37 个技能。把 Claude Code Game Studios（MIT）的 48 个智能体提示词按阶段重组，每个预设只加载本阶段需要的技能。用 dsh plugin add 安装，装完跑一次 node install.mjs 部署预设所引用的技能。

description.en: GitHub panel for DeepSeek Harness: connection status, repository dashboard, profile checklist, and safe metadata edits in one page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 GitHub 面板：连接状态、仓库概览、个人资料检查与安全元数据编辑，集中在一页。

description.en: GitHub console inside DSH: token sign-in, repositories, issues, PRs, commits, notifications, stars and activity, one-click cloning that keeps itself up to date, and a categorized skill library that installs GitHub skill projects for the agent.
description.zh: DSH 内的 GitHub 控制台：令牌登录后查看仓库、议题、拉取请求、提交、通知、星标与动态；一键克隆仓库并自动保持最新；还能把 GitHub 技能项目装进按用途分类、带中文简介与检索关键词的技能库，供 AI 复用。

description.en: Read-only GitHub profile page inside DSH — repo cards with language and stars, plus a one-year contribution heatmap.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏里看 GitHub 档案：仓库卡（语言与星标）与一年贡献热力图，只读公开信息。

description.en: Sync DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspace files to a private GitHub repository for cross-device handoff, with sync badges, search and bulk upload, independent local/remote delete, conflict "pick a side", and multi-device-safe index merging.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话与工作区文件同步到私有 GitHub 仓库，实现跨设备接力；支持同步徽标、搜索与批量上传、本地/远端独立删除、冲突选边，以及多设备安全的索引合并。

description.en: Sets token, cost and wall-clock caps on a DSH goal and blocks that goal when a cap is reached, instead of only reporting the spend. The figures come from the usage events DSH records for the session, priced per model, with a pill beside the composer that opens a per-model breakdown. The official DeepSeek tariff is built in, with peak/off-peak pricing toggleable because it depends on the route; other models are priced from configured rates, and a model with no rate has its tokens counted and its name listed rather than being guessed at.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 goal 设 token、费用与计算时长上限，达到上限即阻断该 goal，而不只是报告花费。数字取自 DSH 为该会话记录的用量事件并按模型计价；输入框旁的 pill 点开是按模型分列的明细。内置 DeepSeek 官方价目，峰谷计价可关闭（它取决于线路）；其他模型用配置的单价，没有单价的模型只计 token 并列出名字，不猜价格。

description.en: Adds a per-session notebook with autosave, a draggable key-information panel with collapsible items and queue injection, notebook and key-information inheritance for native and /fork forks, workspace-scoped session groups, session highlighting, running-workspace prioritization with a blue spinner, and close-current/left/right/all actions on every right-sidebar tab.
description.zh: 为每个会话增加自动保存的笔记本和可拖动关键信息面板，面板支持条目折叠与队列注入；原生分叉和 /fork 会继承笔记本与关键信息；另提供工作区会话组、会话高亮、运行工作区置顶与蓝色转圈指示，以及右侧边栏任意标签的关闭当前/左侧/右侧/全部操作。

description.en: JetBrains IDE bridge for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: installs as a DSH bundle, publishes the authenticated DSH URL, registers the open IDE project, relays the IDE MCP server, and serves a compact tool-window panel with streaming, approvals, Plan/Act, steer sending, session switching and archived-session filtering. The matching IDEA plugin is attached to the same release; your DSH agent can install it.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 JetBrains IDE 桥（Windows）：以 DSH bundle 安装，发布带 token 的 DSH 地址、注册当前 IDE 项目、转发 IDE MCP，并提供带流式输出、审批、Plan/Act、插话、会话切换与归档过滤的精简工具窗口面板；对应的 IDEA 插件附在同一 Release，可由 DSH agent 代装。

description.en: Screen frames, log lines and (on Windows) key/mouse input on one millisecond timeline: record, mark the failing seconds, box the problem on the frame, then hand the agent a keyframe strip, an animated GIF and the aligned log slice.
description.zh: 把屏幕画面、日志和（Windows 上）键鼠输入放在同一条毫秒时间轴上：录完标出问题区间、在画面上拖框标注，再把关键帧条带、动图和对齐后的日志切片连同描述一起交给 Agent。

description.en: Adds an incognito toggle for in-memory DSH conversations with temporary desktop attachment storage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加内存无痕对话开关，桌面附件使用临时存储。

description.en: Local-first bookkeeping plus a separate wealth-holdings ledger: text entries and receipt OCR through an optional local provider, a running balance, a strictly degrading daily profit chain, and a two-section month-end report where cash and wealth totals are never merged.
description.zh: 本地优先的记账插件，附带独立的理财持仓账本：文字记账与小票 OCR（可选本地 OCR 提供方）、running balance、严格降级的每日收益链，以及现金与理财永不合并的月末双节报告。

description.en: Connects litman, a local literature manager driven by the `lit` command, to DSH: a sidebar entry lists your litman libraries and opens one as a workspace in a new session, and a bundled skill, after asking you, installs litman with its official installer and connects litman's own skills.
description.zh: 把 litman（用 `lit` 命令管理的本地文献库）接入 DSH：侧栏入口列出你的 litman 文献库，点一下就在新会话里把它作为工作区打开；自带的 skill 在征得你同意后，用官方安装命令装好 litman，并接入 litman 自己的 skill。

description.en: Delegates mechanical text work (translate, summarize, extract, classify, rewrite) to an Ollama-native or OpenAI-compatible endpoint by file path, so the source text never enters the main model's context. Registers local_transform, local_batch and local_health; per-workspace local-AI levels (none/light/default/high/max) add a local_worker subagent and a plan-only mode; an opt-in SlaveAgentTeams switch discovers mounted model routes, runs parallel child agents with node-level failover, and registers the endpoint chain as llm-pi-ai routes. Configured from the Web GUI; requires a reachable endpoint.
description.zh: 把机械性文本工作（翻译、摘要、抽取、分类、改写）按文件路径交给 Ollama 原生或 OpenAI 兼容端点，正文不进入主模型上下文。注册 local_transform、local_batch、local_health；按项目工作区设置本地 AI 介入程度（无/轻度/默认/更高/最高），高等级下新增 local_worker 子 agent 与「只规划」模式；可选的 SlaveAgentTeams 开关会探测已挂载的模型路由、并行运行子 agent 并在节点失败时切换，同时把端点链注册为 llm-pi-ai 路由。配置在 Web GUI 内完成；需要可达的模型端点。

description.en: Daily longevity coach built on the 64 graded population studies in HowToLiveLonger: a sidebar page with three actions for today, a day timeline, nine situation guides, keyword search over all 64 records and a check-in trail, plus five agent tools that make the model state the A/B/C/D evidence grade before answering questions about sleep, diet, exercise, sitting or supplements.
description.zh: 把 HowToLiveLonger 的 64 条分级人群证据做成日常教练：侧栏页面含今日三件事、一天时间轴、9 个处境场景、64 条证据检索与打卡轨迹，另有 5 个工具让模型在回答作息、饮食、运动、久坐、保健品问题时先说明 A/B/C/D 证据等级。

description.en: A graph of your memory store for DSH: one node per real memory, and every edge must state why the two are connected — a quoted keyword, a shared term, a project, or temporal adjacency. Pure filesystem reads with no model in the loop; unreadable sources are reported, never replaced with fake nodes.
description.zh: DSH 的记忆关系图：每条真实记忆一个点，每条边都得答得出「凭什么连」——引用、共词、归属、按时间补边，四种理由都能读出来。纯读盘、不过模型，读不到就报错，不拿假数据顶上。

description.en: Merges your configured, runtime-registered and locally cached models into one panel, probes and minimal-request tests them, pulls each channel's upstream /v1/models catalog, and chains the keepers into named schemes. A virtual ModelPool provider fails over at request time with per-model cooldowns, exponential backoff, image-request avoidance for text-only models, and a 10-minute memory for rejected reasoning levels. Adds a token ledger by day and model with CSV export, and 21 regression probes. Not a fork of dsh-llm-fallbacks.
description.zh: 把已配置、运行时注册、本地缓存的模型合并进一个面板，做探测与最小请求测试，一键拉每家渠道的上游 /v1/models 目录，再把要留的模型串成命名方案。虚拟 provider ModelPool 在请求发起时顺延，带按模型冷却、指数退避、图片请求避开纯文本模型、被拒思考档位记忆 10 分钟。另有按天与模型的 token 台账（可导 CSV）和 21 个回归探针。不是 dsh-llm-fallbacks 的 fork。

description.en: Runs one task through several configured models at once — in parallel or as a primary/secondary review — and returns each model's answer plus an aggregated digest.
description.zh: 把一个任务同时交给多个已配置模型（并行，或主模型起草 + 副模型复核），返回各模型答案与聚合摘要。

description.en: Git tab that covers the session workspace root together with every additional root registered through multi-root-workspace, so sibling checkouts appear as separate sections with their own branch, ahead/behind, line counts, directory tree and commit history; clicking a file opens its unified diff (or whole content, for untracked files) and clicking a commit opens its patch. Each section also has a commit box that stages and commits only the listed files (`git add -- <files>` + `git commit -- <files>`).
description.zh: Git 页签，把会话主目录与 multi-root-workspace 登记的每个附加根放在一起展示：平级仓库各自一节，带自己的分支、ahead/behind、增删行数、目录树与提交历史；点文件看 unified diff（未跟踪文件显示全文），点提交看该提交的 patch。每节还带提交框，只暂存并提交列出的文件（`git add -- <files>` + `git commit -- <files>`）。

description.en: Ecommerce research for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth into the Nexscope MCP server, marketplace data across Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, Shopee, Temu and 1688, plus a bundled nexscope skill.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的电商研究插件：OAuth 接入 Nexscope MCP，覆盖亚马逊、TikTok Shop、沃尔玛、Shopee、Temu 与 1688 等市场数据，并捆绑 nexscope 技能。

description.en: A handwritten-journal salary timer on the DSH composer dock: set your monthly salary and work hours, then it shows how much you have earned today and this month in real time, plus daily, hourly and per-second rates, progress toward quitting time, hours worked past quitting time, weekday attendance dots and a status badge (working, lunch, off work, unpaid overtime, day off). Settings are kept in localStorage only; no network requests.
description.zh: 挂在 DSH 输入框下方的「牛马费用计时器」手帐小卡——填好到手月薪与上下班时间，实时显示今天已挣多少、本月累计多少，附带日薪/时薪/秒薪、下班进度条、下班后的无偿加班时长、工作日打卡点阵与状态章（打工中、午休中、已下班、无偿加班、休息日）。配置只存在页面 localStorage，不发网络请求。

description.en: Plays a completion chime — the same sound as OpenAI Codex — on turn end or when the agent needs you (approval, question, plan review). Subagent turns are skipped; mute and volume are adjustable.
description.zh: 一轮回复结束、或需要你介入（授权、提问、计划评审）时，播放提示音（与 OpenAI Codex 同款）；忽略 subagent 子会话，可静音与调节音量。

description.en: Off-peak task queue: typing /闲时任务 in a conversation queues a task with no model call at queue time, and DSH runs it in that same conversation during the off-peak hours of the model that conversation uses (DeepSeek off-peak half price, GLM Coding Plan half credits).
description.zh: 闲时任务队列：在对话中输入 /闲时任务 即可入队，入队不产生模型调用；DSH 会在对话所用模型的闲时时段（DeepSeek 半价、GLM Coding Plan 半积分）自动在同一条对话中执行任务。

description.en: Drive a real Chrome and bundle the DOM, accessibility tree, HAR with response bodies, console logs, storage, screenshots, PDF and screencast into one self-contained evidence folder.
description.zh: 用真 Chrome 操控页面，并把 DOM/无障碍树/HAR+响应体/Console/存储/截图/PDF/录屏一键打包成证据目录。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go usage (5-hour, weekly, monthly) in the DSH composer dock and a Settings page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框底栏和设置页显示 OpenCode Go 的 5 小时、本周、本月用量。

description.en: Academic paper reading and citation manager for DeepSeek Harness: left-rail library, original-layout PDF reader, six citation styles, a Word bibliography append, and AI translation/summary/mind-map/term lookup. A derivative of jypjypjypjyp/dsh-paper-reader (now dsh-vibe-reading, MIT) that shares its default ~/.paper_reading work root — do not install both. Requires the dsh-better-sidebar plugin.
description.zh: 面向学生与研究者的论文阅读与引用管理器：左侧栏论文库、原样 PDF 阅读器、六种引用格式、Word 文末参考文献，以及 AI 翻译/概括/思维导图/术语。基于 jypjypjypjyp/dsh-paper-reader（现名 dsh-vibe-reading，MIT）扩展，默认共用 `~/.paper_reading` 工作目录——不要与上游同装。需先安装 dsh-better-sidebar 插件。

description.en: Discourages unnecessary sequential tool calls by guiding the model to batch ready, independent calls, potentially reducing wait time, model round trips, and token use when the runtime supports parallel execution; no scheduler changes.
description.zh: 引导模型将已就绪且互不依赖的工具调用合批，减少不必要的串行调用；在运行时支持并行执行时，有望缩短等待时间、减少模型交互轮次及 token 消耗，不修改调度器。

description.en: Feishu (Lark) bot for DSH remote control — messages become session turns, results return to the chat, and ask-mode approval requests can be approved or denied in Feishu.
description.zh: 飞书机器人远程控制 DSH 会话——消息进入会话，回合结果回到飞书，ask 档的审批可以在飞书里批准或拒绝。

description.en: Inspects a plugin's declarative patch entries and installed code files on its Plugins page.
description.zh: 在插件详情页查看插件的声明式 patch 与安装后的代码文件。

description.en: Scheduled model-news radar: collects official release announcements from LLM vendors through RSS, Hugging Face and GitHub organisation APIs and changelog pages (a 6-vendor sample list is bundled, a user-maintained list is read from ~/.dsh/model-news-radar/sources.json), deduplicates them into daily, weekly or monthly Markdown reports and opens a DSH session that writes the summary. Read-only, no logins, no third-party dependencies.
description.zh: 模型资讯雷达：按厂商官方来源清单（RSS、Hugging Face 与 GitHub 组织接口、变更页；自带 6 家示例清单，完整清单读 ~/.dsh/model-news-radar/sources.json）定时采集大模型发布资讯，去重后写成日报 / 周报 / 月报，并起一个 DSH 会话写摘要。只读，不登录任何平台，无第三方依赖。

description.en: Reusable experience for DeepSeek Harness: save a successful task as a structured playbook, recall it later as a native skill, and gate deliveries behind user-confirmed checks that require objective evidence before write actions are allowed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的经验复用与交付闸门：把成功任务沉淀为结构化 playbook，同质任务自动作为原生 Skill 召回；交付闸门经用户确认后，写文件前必须逐项拿到客观证据，否则动作被硬拦截。

description.en: A white-box rule workbench for DeepSeek Harness: turn plain-language rules into readable, auditable rule chains executed by a deterministic 171-atom forward-chain engine. Business records stay on the machine; rule generation sends field names and rule text only.
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek 把大白话业务规则转成可读、可导出的规则链，再由 171 原子前向链引擎确定性执行；业务数据留在本机，生成规则时只发送字段名与规则文本，附完整逻辑库/数据库工作台。

description.en: A-share and OTC fund dashboard forked from SuCriss/dsh-leekbox (MIT): indices, market boards, limit-up sentiment thermometer, dragon-tiger list, full-market search, a watchlist with in-place position editing and price alerts, a stock detail window with K-line, money flow and F10, a signal screener, 7x24 news, AI stock analysis, and an OTC fund tab with NAV, estimated NAV and a fund detail window showing stage returns, a NAV chart and the disclosed top-10 holdings with live quotes. It keeps upstream's /api/leekbox/* routes and $DSH_HOME/.leekbox-*.json data files, so install it instead of SuCriss/dsh-leekbox rather than alongside it.
description.zh: 持仓看板：A 股与场外基金看板，fork 自 SuCriss/dsh-leekbox（MIT）——大盘指数、板块、涨停情绪温度计、龙虎榜、全市场搜索、可原地编辑持仓成本与份额并带价格预警的自选、含 K 线 / 资金流向 / F10 的个股详情浮窗、技术信号选股、7×24 快讯、AI 个股分析，以及带净值与估值、阶段涨幅、净值曲线和最新披露前十大重仓实时涨跌的场外基金页。它沿用上游的 /api/leekbox/* 路由与 $DSH_HOME/.leekbox-*.json 数据文件，请替代而非并装 SuCriss/dsh-leekbox。

description.en: Turn rough ideas into precise prompts for 19 image/video generation, writing, code and text models, with multi-model enhancement, prompt scoring, image-to-prompt and a periodic self-updating knowledge base.
description.zh: 把粗糙想法变成精准提示词：内置 19 个目标模型规范（含豆包 Seedream/Seedance 等）、多模型增强、提示词评分诊断、图片反推，并周期联网自更新本地知识库。

description.en: Trimmed derivative of HunYiSage/dsh-purge (formerly YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge) — do not install both, since both use the `dsh-purge` package name and row id: system-prompt injection and host patching for DeepSeek Harness, with reversible patches, a /purge command, CLI and HTTP status endpoints.
description.zh: HunYiSage/dsh-purge（原 YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge）的精简衍生版——不要与上游同装：两者使用同一个 `dsh-purge` 包名与行 id。功能为 DeepSeek Harness 提示词注入与宿主补丁，提供可逆补丁、/purge 命令、命令行与 HTTP 状态接口。

description.en: Clears four kinds of idle-only system notices (approval policy, working directory, plan mode, plugin changes) that DeepSeek Harness counts as active work, so quitting with no running tasks no longer warns about interrupted work.
description.zh: 清除四类被 DeepSeek Harness 误算为“有任务”的空闲系统通知（审批策略、工作目录、计划模式、插件变更），让没有任务运行时退出不再弹出“任务将会中断”的警告。

description.en: Gives hand-declared models on custom or relay routes a vendor-matched reasoning-effort picker: detects Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, Gemini, Grok, Doubao or MiMo from the model id, display name or endpoint host, fills in only the levels that vendor accepts plus the pi-ai compat fields its request format needs, and writes them into the profile config so the Models page reasoning switch turns on. Models you edit or switch off are left alone, and a Models page card hands them back on request.
description.zh: 为自定义路由或中转站上手动添加的模型提供按厂商匹配的推理等级选择：根据模型 id、显示名或接口域名识别 Claude、GPT、DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi、Qwen、Gemini、Grok、豆包或 MiMo，只填入该厂商接受的档位，并补上对应请求格式所需的 pi-ai compat 字段，再写回 profile 配置，让「设置 → 模型」里的推理开关自动打开。你手动改过或关掉的模型不会被改动，可在模型设置页的卡片上一键交回插件。

description.en: Research workflow suite that registers 10 domain skills and 7 tools, curates 592 bundled research skills into 103 capability cards with an auditable per-skill ledger, and takes over research requests automatically through a system-prompt section.
description.zh: 科研全流程插件：注册 10 个领域技能与 7 个工具，把随包 592 条科研技能整理成 103 张能力卡并附 586 条可审计的判定账本，通过系统提示段自动接管科研任务。

description.en: Reverse-engineering agent preset. Mounts REA (rea-agents) as MCP tools for native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, managed assemblies, archives and installers — the full 170-tool catalog by default — but only inside sessions that select the preset; other presets load nothing. Ships an install-time check that reports which native analysis engine (Hopper, Ghidra, IDA) is present and prints the env snippet to wire one in. A fork of dsh-rea (JeremyWangCY, MIT) retargeted as an agent preset; do not install it together with dsh-rea.
description.zh: 逆向工程 agent 预设。把 REA（rea-agents）的原生二进制、JavaScript/Electron、托管程序集、归档与安装包分析能力作为 MCP 工具挂载——默认全量 170 个——但只在选择该预设的会话里生效，其它预设零加载。附带安装后环境自检：报告本机已装哪个原生分析引擎（Hopper / Ghidra / IDA），并给出接入所需的 env 片段。本插件是 dsh-rea（JeremyWangCY，MIT）的二次开发分支，改为 agent 预设，请勿与上游 dsh-rea 同时安装。

description.en: Mirrors an Android phone screen to a Windows PC over USB or Wi-Fi with scrcpy, and exposes start, stop, status, connect (reconnect after a phone reboot) and screenshot as an agent tool and a /mirror command. Requires scrcpy and adb installed on the host (winget install Genymobile.scrcpy); the plugin does not bundle them.
description.zh: 用 scrcpy 把安卓手机画面投到 Windows 电脑（USB 或无线），并把启动、停止、状态、connect（手机重启后重连）、截图暴露为智能体工具与 /mirror 命令。需在本机装好 scrcpy 与 adb（winget install Genymobile.scrcpy），插件不打包这两个可执行文件。

description.en: One-click screenshot for the DSH composer: a scissors button (Shift+click hides the window first) opens a native full-screen crop overlay with window detection, drag-to-move and 8-direction border resize, then attaches the cropped PNG through the composer paste pipeline. Windows only, DSH desktop app 0.2.1 or later.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的截图插件：剪刀按钮（Shift+点击先隐藏窗口）唤起原生全屏裁剪遮罩，支持窗口识别、选区拖动与八向边缘缩放，裁剪结果经输入框粘贴管线自动附为图片。仅支持 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面端（0.2.1 及以上）。

description.en: Self-hosted SearXNG search provider: the bundled installer sets up and supervises a local instance on macOS/Linux/WSL (needs git and Python 3.11+), key-less and tracking-free; it probes the engines your network can reach and applies the recommended set in one click.
description.zh: 自建 SearXNG 搜索源：随包脚本在 macOS/Linux/WSL 上安装并守护本地实例（需 git 与 Python 3.11+），免 API Key、无追踪；实测本机各引擎的可达性与延迟后，一键应用推荐集。

description.en: Agent-asked secrets for DeepSeek Harness: a masked card stores API keys and tokens in the local credential store without them entering the chat, then injects them into one command.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供向用户索取密钥的插件：遮罩卡片把 API 密钥和令牌存入本地凭据库，不进入聊天记录，并只在单条命令中注入。

description.en: Exact per-session spend for DeepSeek Harness, billed request by request at the peak or off-peak rate in force when that request was sent.
description.zh: 在会话状态栏精确显示本会话累计花费：按每次请求各自的时段价与所用模型分别计费。

description.en: A free-form grouping layer for the DSH sidebar: nest sessions from different workspaces into draggable groups without changing workspace membership or logs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏官方工作区管理之上增加一层独立自由分组：不同工作区的会话可归入同一多层分组，支持拖拽、搜索、恢复和可选 AI 控制，不改变原工作区归属与日志。

description.en: Session-first DSH sidebar: pinned, active and recent sections, workspace grouping, focus groups, search and a session trash bin.
description.zh: DSH 的会话优先左侧栏：置顶、活跃、最近分区，工作区分组，专注模式，搜索与会话回收站。

description.en: Manage local skills across AI agents with version comparison, shared-directory consolidation, and recoverable migration and deletion.
description.zh: 管理多个 AI Agent 的本地技能，支持版本比较、合并到公用目录，以及可恢复的迁移和删除。

description.en: Sticky-note wall in the sidebar: six paper colors, pin and search, up to six images per note, local backups, and an agent tool that lets a session or an IM bot add a note without opening the browser.
description.zh: 侧栏便利贴墙：六种纸色、置顶与搜索、单条最多六张图片、本地备份，并提供模型工具，会话或 IM 机器人无需打开浏览器就能贴一条。

description.en: Sticky-note wall in the sidebar with pasted images and text, due reminders, done state, shortcuts, a pin-on-top floating window, appearance skins, and a native always-on-top Windows desktop window.
description.zh: 左侧栏便签墙：粘贴图片与文本、到期提醒、完成状态、快捷键、可置顶浮窗、外观皮肤，以及 Windows 桌面置顶窗口。

description.en: Sticky notes on a wall, with four paper stocks, five inks, seven typefaces, four text sizes and your choice of tape, clip or pin.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的便签墙：四种纸面、五种墨色、七种字体、四档字号，胶带或回形针或图钉固定，随手记下自动保存。

description.en: Sidebar page that removes burned-in subtitles from a video with a local video-subtitle-remover checkout: frame preview with a start/end range, drag-drawn regions (up to six), automatic region detection reviewed by a DSH chat model, live before/after comparison, and open-file/open-folder on the result. Requires the video-subtitle-remover checkout with its models and a Python environment with torch, paddle and OpenCV.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏里调用本机 video-subtitle-remover 引擎擦除视频硬字幕：画面帧按开始/结束时段预览、拖拽框选最多六个区域、自动识别字幕带并由 DSH 模型复核、处理中实时前后对比，成片可一键打开或定位到文件夹。需预先准备 video-subtitle-remover 仓库（含模型）与装有 torch、paddle、OpenCV 的 Python 环境。

description.en: Predicts the next user message as composer ghost text using the configured DSH model; Tab fills the draft without sending, with time-aware context and cached suggestions.
description.zh: 使用 DSH 已配置模型预测下一句，在输入框显示灰字，Tab 仅填入草稿；结合当前时间理解旧对话，并缓存建议。

description.en: Adds a hover toolbar to every Markdown table in DSH Web: one button copies the table as Markdown, the other copies a 2x PNG of it taken with the current theme background.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 里每张 Markdown 表格加一条悬停工具条：一个按钮把表格复制成 Markdown，另一个按钮把它按当前主题背景截成 2 倍图 PNG。

description.en: Agent Teams management for the DSH Web GUI: inspect the teammates of any session, delete a role together with its session (the session folder moves to a recoverable trash), reclaim the freed member slot on pre-0.2.2-rc.1 teams, keep deleted members out of the subagent picker and the team roster, and restore a read-only members panel in the session header on 0.2.2-rc.1+ — works with both the old and the new Agent Teams implementations without patching DSH.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的智能体团队管理：查看任意会话的成员，删除角色及其持久会话（目录移入回收站，可恢复），在 0.2.2-rc.1 之前的旧版团队上回收释放的成员名额，让已删除成员不再出现在子智能体选择器与团队面板，并在 0.2.2-rc.1+ 恢复会话页头的只读成员面板；新旧两版智能体团队实现都能用，不需要改 DSH 源码。

description.en: Assigns a model and reasoning effort to each Agent Teams teammate, from the chat toolbar or a settings page.
description.zh: 为每个 Agent Teams 队友单独指定模型与推理强度，可在聊天工具行或设置页切换。

description.en: Gives one conversation a pinned as-of point and a dated evidence window on both sides — \[as_of − before, as_of + after], past, future or BC. In restricted mode the agent is told the active window once per change, web_search results are filtered to dated sources inside the window and undated sources are rejected, and the first reply must echo the window (a missing echo gets one nudge). It also narrates long silent background jobs with deterministic \[TIME FACT] facts and exposes a read-only time_pin_status tool; default mode injects nothing and filters nothing.
description.zh: 为单个对话钉住 as_of 时间点与前后两侧的带日期证据窗口——\[as_of − before, as_of + after]，支持过去、未来与公元前。在受限模式下，窗口变化时只告知一次当前窗口，web_search 结果按发布日期过滤到窗口内、无日期来源一律排除，首条回复必须确认窗口（缺失时纠正一次）。另对长时间静默的后台任务给出确定性 \[TIME FACT] 播报，并提供只读的 time_pin_status 工具；默认模式不注入、不过滤。

description.en: Writes one model and reasoning effort into every session at once from a control beside the composer model picker, since the shipped picker only changes the session you are in. Sessions that already match are skipped, subagent sessions follow their parent instead of being written, and the same selection can be pinned as the default for new sessions.
description.zh: 在输入框模型位旁加一个控件，一次把同一个模型与思考程度写进所有会话——官方模型选择器只改当前会话。已一致的会话会跳过，子代理会话跟随父会话而不被单独写入，也可把同一选择钉为新建会话的默认值。

description.en: Renders WorkBuddy SOUL, USER, MEMORY and topic Markdown files into the DeepSeek Harness system prompt, with a byte budget and a settings page.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 的 SOUL / USER / MEMORY / topics 渲染进 DeepSeek Harness 的 system prompt，带字节预算与设置页。

description.en: Exposes Chrome DevTools Protocol to the agent through 17 tools for page summaries, element locators, activity timelines, console, network, storage and downloads, reading either a browser the plugin launches on its own or the tab the user is currently browsing through a small browser extension.
description.zh: 通过 17 个工具把 Chrome DevTools Protocol 接给 agent，提供页面概览、元素定位、操作时间线、控制台、网络、登录态与下载，读取对象可以是插件自带的专用浏览器，也可以经浏览器扩展读取你当前正在浏览的标签页。

description.en: Adds a Windows system-proxy switch to DeepSeek Harness: toggles the HKCU Internet Settings proxy with a WinINET refresh, together with the git, npm and pip proxy settings, from chat, the /proxy command or a Settings page.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 系统代理开关：写注册表并通知 WinINET 重载，同时切换 git、npm、pip 的代理配置，支持对话、/proxy 命令和设置页三个入口。

description.en: Configurable serial agent-team workflows with a Manager, role Actors, an independent Judge, and a visual workflow editor.
description.zh: 可配置的串行 Agent 团队工作流，提供 Manager、角色 Actor、独立 Judge 和可视化工作流编辑器。

description.en: Adds a Chats/Files switch to the left-sidebar Workspace header that swaps the session list for a lazily loaded tree of the current session's workspace. Files and folders can be dragged into the composer as @path references; clicking a file opens the built-in preview; the right-click menu reveals a file in the system file manager or copies its path; entries carry VS Code-style Git status (modified, untracked, added, deleted, conflict, ignored) relative to the last commit.
description.zh: 在左侧栏「工作区」标题旁加入「对话 | 文件」切换，把会话列表换成当前会话工作区的按需加载文件树。文件和文件夹可拖进输入框作为 @路径 引用；单击文件打开自带预览；右键可在系统文件管理器中打开所在文件夹或复制路径；条目按 VS Code 的方式显示相对最近一次提交的 Git 状态（修改、未跟踪、新增、删除、冲突、忽略）。

description.en: Folder organization for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: display-only Workspace folders (drag a Workspace onto a folder block to file it, nest and re-order folders, collapse with counts), durable per-Workspace nested Session folders, and per-row icons chosen from 40 host icons or 48 emoji. A fork of WSNMM3/dsh-session-keeper (MIT, itself derived from ht719/dsh-session-categories); it replaces the sidebar.workspaces region, so do not install it alongside the upstream plugins.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加原生手感的文件夹组织：纯显示的工作区文件夹（把工作区拖到文件夹整块区域即可归档、嵌套、排序、折叠），每个工作区独立且持久化的多层会话文件夹，以及 40 个原生图标 + 48 个 Emoji 的逐行图标自定义。本插件是 WSNMM3/dsh-session-keeper（MIT，源自 ht719/dsh-session-categories）的分叉，会替换 sidebar.workspaces 区域，不能与上游插件同时安装。

description.en: Deletes a whole workspace together with its conversations in one pass - session logs, projection caches and workspace registrations - and optionally sends the workspace folder to the Windows Recycle Bin (on other platforms deletions are permanent).
description.zh: 整块删除工作区及其对话：会话日志、投影缓存与工作区登记一次清掉，可选把工作区目录移入回收站（仅 Windows；其它平台直接永久删除）。

description.en: Moves a session from one workspace to another by dragging it in the sidebar: a confirmation dialog first, subagent sessions travel with the parent, the list auto-scrolls at its edges, and an open idle session takes the move immediately through a registry refresh; moving into or out of the ungrouped group works both ways.
description.zh: 在侧栏把会话从一个工作区拖到另一个工作区，确认后移动会话日志与归属（含子代理、列表边缘自动滚动，已打开的空闲会话经注册表刷新即时生效），未分组双向拖动同样支持。

description.en: LAN pets for DeepSeek Harness. Neighbors' pets visit your desktop, and yours can visit theirs with a note or file along. Desktop pets need DSH Desktop (Electron) on macOS or Windows; on Linux or the web profile, discovery and visits still work but the desktop layer is unavailable.
description.zh: 让同一局域网里的 DSH 宠物互相看见、互相串门，还能捎一张字条或一个文件。桌面宠物需要 macOS 或 Windows 上的 DSH Desktop（Electron）；在 Linux 或 web profile 上，发现和串门仍可用，但没有桌面层。

description.en: A draggable floating card for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that combines a Pomodoro timer, an off-work countdown, and focus statistics. Each launch opens on a fresh focus phase; phase completion triggers a chime, card shake, and particle burst. Includes today's pomodoros, focus minutes, streak and a 7-day chart, rhythm reminders for wrapping up and eye rest, optional system notifications, tab-title timer, auto-start, +5 minutes, and a custom long-break interval.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的悬浮卡片，集成番茄钟、下班倒计时与专注统计。每次启动默认进入专注时段；阶段结束有提示音、卡片抖动与粒子动画。含今日番茄数、专注时长、连续天数与近 7 天柱状图，下班收尾与护眼节律提醒，并可选系统通知、标签页倒计时、自动开始下一阶段、+5 分钟与自定义长休轮数。

description.en: Meihua Yishu (plum-blossom) divination for DSH: cast a hexagram from chat or the panel by time, number, character or manual method; read primary, mutual and changed hexagrams, moving line and body/use relations; keep a local journal of readings, omens and study notes.
description.zh: 梅花易数卜卦插件：在聊天里或面板上按时间、数字、一字占、手动指定四种方式起卦，输出主卦、互卦、变卦、动爻与体用生克，并把卦例、外应与学习笔记保存在本机。

description.en: Run AI commands in real NyaTerm terminal sessions, reusing saved groups, jump hosts and local terminals, with a per-workspace allowlist; commands stay visible and auditable in NyaTerm.
description.zh: 在 NyaTerm 的真实终端会话里执行 AI 命令，复用已配置的分组、跳板机和本地终端，按工作区限制可用范围；命令与输出留在 NyaTerm 中，便于查看和审计。

description.en: Retro pixel CRT overlay for DSH showing the DeepSeek account balance and live token usage.
description.zh: 复古像素 CRT 的 DSH 浮层，实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与 Token 用量。

description.en: Slumber Pavilion physically moves archived DSH sessions out of the load path into ~/DSH-Archive, and ships archive, read, restore and delete tools for them.
description.zh: 沉眠阁把 DSH 里已归档会话的日志与投影记录真正搬出加载路径，并提供归档、读取、还原、删除会话的工具。

description.en: Save conversations, manage notes with images, export files, and sync across devices through your own private GitHub repository.
description.zh: 保存会话、管理图文笔记、导出文件，通过自己的 GitHub 私有仓库跨设备同步。

description.en: 同步 DSH 会话到私有 GitHub 仓库，实现跨设备接力
description.zh: 把本地 DSH 会话同步到你自己的私有 GitHub 仓库，换台电脑也能接着聊。

description.en: DSH multimodal plugin prototype: settings page, image output, map/web cards
description.zh: 把 Office、Notion、GitHub 等工作软件的 MCP 服务器统一挂载管理，随插件装卸，不污染配置。

description.en: Contract suite: one-command install for dsh-legal-intake and dsh-legal-clause.
description.zh: 一条命令装齐法律文书受理与条款审查两个插件，合同处理开箱即用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 投标符合性响应台账核对：依据《中华人民共和国招标投标法》《中华人民共和国招标投标法实施条例》（1999年8月30日通过，2017年12月27日修正、国务院令第613号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 按招标文件逐条核对投标响应台账，只提示漏项和差异，不替你下结论。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 商品归类台账核对：依据《中华人民共和国进出口税则》《商品名称及编码协调制度》（国务院令第392号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查商品归类台账里的编码结构，核对十位商品码及其章、品目、子目前缀是否层层对应。
